completion_data.completion_summary: Added pr task type routing to cslib extension: manifest.json routing entries, index-entries.json language scoping for 3 PR-relevant context files, new skill-pr-implementation/SKILL.md with pr_ready postflight transition, and EXTENSION.md documentation updates.

artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for pr task type routing in cslib extension

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new task type to a cslib extension manifest, three routing entries are needed (research, plan, implement). The implement entry requires a custom skill if the postflight status differs from the default (e.g., pr_ready instead of implement/completed). Context injection for the new task type is activated by adding the type string to load_when.languages arrays in index-entries.json.
